articles.headline: Parliament's joint sitting ratifies emergency, governor's rule in KP
articles.summary: AI summary: Meeting jointly, both houses of Parliament backed the federal government's resolutions placing Khyber Pakhtunkhwa under emergency and governor's rule, after a procedural motion carried 214-56 amid opposition protests. Ministers cited the PTI-led provincial government's alleged withdrawal from counterterrorism efforts, while PTI and JUI-F lawmakers rejected the move and said no evidence was presented.

articles.headline: TTAP says 'no talks' with govt until meeting with Imran Khan is arranged, health details are provided
articles.summary: AI summary: The opposition alliance TTAP, led by Mehmood Khan Achakzai, suspended negotiations with the government, conditioning any resumption on access to jailed PTI founder Imran Khan and information on his health. It also demanded an end to the KP emergency and governor's rule and the release of detained officials, and said it would go to the Peshawar High Court.

articles.headline: FCC disposes of Marwat's plea challenging Sohail Afridi's appointment as KP CM
articles.summary: AI summary: The Federal Constitutional Court closed MNA Sher Afzal Marwat's challenge to Sohail Afridi's election as KP chief minister, ruling it moot since Afridi is out of office under the province's emergency and governor's rule. The bench said the petition could be revived if Afridi is restored, and Marwat said he would now challenge the emergency itself.

political.reason: Closes one legal dispute while signalling a fresh challenge to the emergency; no net change yet.

articles.headline: Teacher, 32 students killed in Peshawar school roof collapse
articles.summary: AI summary: The roof of a private school in Peshawar's Afridi Abad area gave way and crushed classrooms below, killing over 30 people, mostly children under 14 plus at least one teacher, with tolls ranging from 30 to 35 across outlets and dozens injured. Officials blamed a weak, overloaded structure; police arrested the school owner, inquiries were ordered, and the KP governor directed a safety audit of school buildings.

political.reason: Prompts inquiries and audits but no institutional disruption.

social.reason: Mass loss of children's lives exposes serious gaps in school building safety.
